Avyaktopaniṣad
also called Avyaktanṛsiṁhopaniṣad because of the glorification of Nṛsiṁha therein. Adyar Up. I. p. 139. Ānandāśrama 6423. Bhr. 487. Haug 44. IO. 493-4 (86). Mad. Uni. R. K. S. 136 (e). 457. MD. 280. 281. Mu7nchen 185 (p. 118). Mysore D. I. 213. 247. Oppert I. 7828. II. 3101. Up. Br. Mutt 409.
Pt.. (1) Śrī Upaniṣado p.. 725-726. 1913 with Gujarati notes. (2) Upaniṣadāvalī Pt. V. work no. 36. 1920. with Bengali transl. (3) Vaiṣṇava Upaniṣads, Adyar Library Ser. 8. 1923. 2nd edn. 1953.
For a. Eng. transl. with text in Roman, see JAOS. Vol. 60. No. 3 [Page430-a. p.. 338-355 an. Adyar Libr. Ser. 52. 1945.
--C. Bhāṣya. Anu. adv. by Appayya Dīkṣitācārya. Mysore I. p. 458.
--C. by Upaniṣad Brahman.
Pt.. Vaiṣṇava Upaniṣads, Adyar Library Ser. 8. 1923. 2nd edn. 1953.
For a. abstract of the above forming part of Upaniṣanmahimanirūpaṇa, see Taylor II. 469.

Avyayānubhavamahādeyāśrama_(?)
--Tantravārttikaṭīkā-Tantracintāmaṇi or Tantraṭīkānibandhana. Baroda 1430 (I. iii). (Col. iti zrImatparamahaMsaparivrAjakAcArya siddhabhagavadavyayAnubhavamahAdevAzramAparanAmaviracite tantracintAmaNau tantraTIkAnivandhe prathamAdhyAyasya tRtIyaH pAdaH smRticaraNAkhyaH)
For Ayyayānubhava, guru of Ānandānubhava (a. of Vedāntacandra), see the previous entry; for the Mahādevāśrama [Page431-a.
--Ānandānubhava--Viśvanāthāśrama confusion, see Tarakadīpikā, BORI. 379 of 1875-76 an. 281 of 1882-83. L. 3111. MT. 3092 (a.; an. Nyāyasāraṭīkā-Nyāyakalānidhi, BORI. 776 of 1884-87. MT. 5747.
